text:
tess: Incoming pen-test intake from ProbeWorks. They want access to evidence + a 2-day retest window after fixes. Who owns assessor role and export redaction? cc @maria @arjun @sam

sam: I'll take RBAC mapping and JIRA tracking. We should avoid long-lived creds for vendors. Ephemeral OIDC role + short TTL sounds right.

maria: Agreed. KMS policy must NOT allow broad Decrypt. We'll add a key policy statement allowing kms:Decrypt only when caller is the AssessorRole ARN and sourceIp matches vendor netblock.

arjun: For artifact delivery, I prefer presigned S3 URLs + a separate access log bucket. TTL 24h by default. If they need multiple downloads give them a short AssumeRole to read the presigned objects.

skevin: Can we export inference logs but redact prompts? Compliance wants proof that we removed prompts before release. Propose we replace prompt text with SHA256(prompt) and keep a mapping only in the sec vault.

maria: Good approach. We'll add a script to stream logs and mask fields:
```bash
python redact_logs.py --input /var/log/inference.log --output s3://pt-evidence/probeworks/redacted/ --mask-fields prompt,text
```

arjun: Detection & telemetry: create SIEM rule to alert on AssumeRole where principal is external and actions include kms:Decrypt or s3:GetObject. Log to #sec-alerts and create Jira PT-ALERT-<id>.

sam: Remediation priority (for retest scheduling):
- P0: remote auth bypass, KMS key misuse (exposed key policy), exfiltration paths
- P1: missing audit trails, presigned URL privileges, insecure logs
- P2: low-impact info exposure
Owners please ack and ETA for P0 items.

tess: Triage is live. Tentatively: maria for KMS changes, arjun for exports & SIEM rules, sam for RBAC docs + evidence packaging. I'll create tickets and link here.

ops-bot: Reminder: PT sync in 20 minutes — https://meet.link/pt-bridge :bell:

maria: Draft key policy snippet I plan to propose:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowAssessorDecrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AssessorRole"]},"Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*","Condition":{"IpAddress":{"aws:SourceIp":"203.0.113.0/24"}}}]}
```

arjun: I'll register a CloudTrail export job: daily exports of management & data events -> s3://pt-raw-trail/ with server-side encryption using the same evidence key. We'll keep weekly snapshots (immutable) for 7 days, raw for 90 days.

skevin: The runtime team needs to emit KV-cache flush events — add event type runtime.kv_cache.flush with keys hashed. We must ensure no prompt text leaves runtime.

sam: For retest windows probe prefers Thu mornings next week or Mon afternoon. Propose we offer Thu 09:00-12:00 or Mon 13:00-16:00. Which works for owners?

tess: Locking Thu 09:00-12:00. I'll send invite once JIRA board is updated. Vendor wants 48h notice before they start.

maria: After role creation I'll paste the ARN here and the presigned URL pattern. Will require vendor to rotate their ephemeral cert and present commitment to not persist data.

arjun: SIEM rule (pseudo-sql):
```sql
select * from cloudtrail where eventName in ("AssumeRole","Decrypt") and userIdentity.type = 'AssumedRole' and userIdentity.arn like '%AssessorRole%'
```
Alert -> create ticket -> tag PT-SEC.

sam: Evidence packaging: include hashes and redacted logs, list of CVEs found, repro steps, and timeline. Keep a manifest.json with metadata but remove any prod identifiers.

skevin: Small ask: include test harness run IDs and runtime stable hashes so vendor can correlate without seeing prompt text. We'll provide prompt-hash mapping only to internal sec vault for audit.

tess: Checklist I'm adding to the intake doc:
1) Create AssessorRole (TTL 48-72h) + assume policy
2) Apply KMS key policy restrictions + security review
3) Implement redact pipeline and S3 presigned packaging
4) Add SIEM rules + export schedule
5) Create JIRA tickets + assign owners
6) Schedule retest slot and notify vendor

arjun: I'll also add an automated playbook to revoke the AssessorRole if anomalous activity detected. Put a detection TTL: any more than 10 Decrypt attempts in 1h -> revoke.

maria: ETA for initial KMS policy change: EOD tomorrow. I need one quick review from security.

sam: RBAC docs + JIRA board by EOD today. Owners — please update tickets with ETA when you can.

tess: Uploading scope doc: https://internal.docs/pt/probeworks/scope (will post updated link after assets uploaded).

ops-bot: Note: Evidence bucket lifecycle configured: 7-day immutable snapshots + 90-day raw retention.

kevin: FYI legal asked for a data-processing addendum signed before any decrypted evidence exchange. I'll coordinate with compliance.

maria: Will delay handing decrypted artifacts until legal sign-off is recorded. Keep presigned links inactive until then.

sam: Good catch. Add legal block in the checklist.

tess: I'll update intake doc and close loop. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the kickoff to lock the retest date and confirm ETAs.

ops-bot: PT kickoff scheduled — Thu 09:00. Attendance requested: @maria @arjun @sam @tess @kevin
